recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure viewed from behind, standing in a wide-legged stance atop a lush green hill. The figure wears a distressed Union Jack patterned frock coat. The background features a vibrant green countryside, a body of water, and a deep blue sky with wispy white clouds. Typography is positioned at the top, utilizing a mix of boxed and loose letterforms.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure anchors the vertical axis against a horizontal landscape.
The red and white of the coat pop against the dominant green and blue environment.
The distressed texture of the coat contrasts with the smooth gradient of the sky.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically, occupying the middle third of the frame horizontally; full-length figure from the waist up to the head, legs extending to the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The convergence of the Union Jack pattern at the center of the figure's back.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the head, follows the spine down to the hands clasped behind the back, then radiates outward to the landscape and upward to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and rolling hills provide significant breathing room around the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep sky blue and vibrant grass green (environment).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Red and white (Union Jack pattern) providing high-frequency contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/Yellow in the landscape and text box border.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all channels, creating a surreal, hyper-real quality.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name in a bold, high-contrast serif within a rectangular frame.
Secondary title in a light, spaced-out sans-serif or slab-serif.
Intentional kerning gaps in the secondary text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Irregular spacing between letters to create a rhythmic, disjointed feel.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, boxed serif paired with a light, airy, widely-spaced sans/slab serif.
graphicDevices: Double-bordered rectangular frame for primary text
Distressed texture overlays on the subject's clothing

preserve: The boxed layout for the first word
The extreme tracking for the second word

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast serif for the boxed display text.
Small caps feel with sharp terminals for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a person from behind, standing on a vibrant green hill overlooking a valley with a river. The person is wearing a long, distressed frock coat with a Union Jack flag pattern. The sky is a deep, saturated blue with scattered white clouds. The lighting is bright and surreal.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rectangular box in the top left corner with a gold border. Inside the box, place bold serif text in magenta. To the right of the box, place light-weight slab-serif text in pale blue with very wide, irregular letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the subject facing away from the camera?
Is the Union Jack pattern visible and distressed?
Is the primary text contained within a bordered box?
Is the secondary text widely and irregularly spaced?

adjustableVariables: Density of clouds in the sky
Width of the text box border

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's back
Clean, graphic integration of text and image
avoid: Soft focus or bokeh in the background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the coat pattern is clearly recognizable as a flag motif.
Check that the text box does not obscure the subject's head.
Verify the horizon line is straight and positioned in the lower third.
Confirm the magenta text color pops against the dark background of its box.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central back-view figure + Distressed iconic pattern + Saturated landscape + Boxed/Spaced typography header.
